meaning:
περι-κάθαρμα, -τος, τό
(περικαθαίρω, to purify on all sides or completely, Deu.18:10, Jos.5:4, 4Ma.1:29*), [in LXX: Pro.21:18 (כֹּפֶר)* ;]
1. a victim, expiation (Pr, l.with).
2. refuse, rubbish: pl., 1Co.4:13 (see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
